description: This file provides services to resolve project names from project IDs using cross-collection lookups with caching, involving models like AppDeployments, Projects, SessionTracking, Costs, Tenants, and Users.

methods.name: getCached
methods.description: Retrieve cached project name if available and not expired.

methods.name: setCached
methods.description: Cache a project name with a TTL.

methods.name: buildProjectIdOrQuery
methods.description: Build a case-insensitive query to match project ID across multiple fields.

methods.name: pickNameFromDeployment
methods.description: Select project name from deployment document based on precedence.

methods.name: pickNameFromProject
methods.description: Select project name from project document.

methods.name: pickNameFromSession
methods.description: Select project name from session tracking document.

methods.name: pickNameFromCost
methods.description: Select project name from cost document.

methods.name: pickNameFromTenant
methods.description: Select project name from tenant document.

methods.name: pickNameFromUser
methods.description: Select project name from user document.

methods.name: lookupProjectName
methods.description: Sequentially query different collections to find a project name based on project ID.

methods.name: resolveProjectName
methods.description: Public method to resolve a project name for a given project ID, with caching.

methods.name: resolveProjectNames
methods.description: Bulk resolve multiple project IDs to names, utilizing cache and sequential lookup.
